# site/

The static guide website for the mods, published with GitHub Pages at https://horef.github.io/claude-plugins/ by `.github/workflows/pages.yml` whenever `site/` changes on `main`. Plain HTML and one shared `style.css`; no build step. Look here to change the guide pages.
